Invitation.title: Personalized Wedding Invitation
Invitation.description: A unique, shareable guest invitation tied to a permanent URL slug and static QR code.

slug.description: Immutable unique URL slug matching the Firestore document ID.

side.description: Whether the guest is invited from the Bride Side (Medha) or Groom Side (Saptarshi).

guestNames.description: Ordered list of invitee names with exact spelling preserved (1 to 20 entries).

withFamily.description: Whether '& Family' is included for this invitation.

displayGuestName.description: Combined display string for cards, QR print layouts, and greetings.

eventIds.description: List of fixed WeddingEvent IDs this guest is invited to (1 to 20 entries).

rsvp.description: Optional per-event guest RSVP responses keyed by event ID, or null when pending/cleared.

isGeneric.description: Optional flag indicating a nameless generic invitation backed by a unique DB guest code.

InvitationRsvp.title: Per-Event Guest RSVP Map
InvitationRsvp.description: Map of per-event RSVP entries (byEvent) and server respondedAt timestamp.

byEvent.description: Map keyed by fixed WeddingEvent IDs (mehendi-cocktail, aiburobhat, haldi, wedding, boubhat, reception) storing EventRsvpEntry objects.

respondedAt.description: Server timestamp when RSVP was last submitted or updated.

EventRsvpEntry.title: Single Event RSVP Response
EventRsvpEntry.description: Attendance, headcount, food preference, and alcohol preference for one wedding event.

attending.description: Whether the guest is coming or not coming to this event.

headcount.description: Number of guests attending (1-50 for withFamily invitations, 1 for individual invitations) when coming, or null when not_coming.

foodPreference.description: Optional Veg or Non-Veg dining preference when coming (nullable if cleared or not_coming).

alcoholPreference.description: Optional Alcohol or No Alcohol preference ONLY for mehendi-cocktail when coming (always null for all other events or when cleared/not_coming).

/invitations/{slug}.description: Personalized guest invitations keyed by immutable unique URL slug, including per-event RSVP details.
